verdict.rationale: A state government's digital filing services could plausibly publish their portal source under an open license, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions source code, a public repository, or any open-source license for the Ohio Secretary of State's systems or the Business Gateway. The cited items cover only portal features, OHID sign-in, tax services, and robots.txt access walls, none of which bear on source openness.
